Subject: Post-demo: Buying committee recap & next steps (PaymentsInc)

Hi Samantha (and team),

Thanks again for your time today — great conversation and lots of useful signal about the buying committee and evaluation criteria. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum.

Key attendees we heard today:
- Samantha Li (VP Product) — Champion / primary product questions
- Tom Baker (CISO) — Security & compliance lead
- Elena Martinez (Head of Integrations) — Implementation lead / timeline
- Potential economic buyer: Olivia Chen (CFO) — we asked about finance involvement; she was mentioned as final approver

Top decision criteria we heard:
- Security & compliance: SOC 2, DPA, encryption + KMS support, audit logs
- Latency & cost predictability at peak traffic (card-not-present flows)
- Deployment options: private VPC vs hosted with restricted region
- Integration effort and SDK support for Java/Go

Immediate asks we heard from Tom / procurement: SOC 2 report, standard DPA, high-level network architecture for private deployment, and an initial procurement SOW + pricing.

Proposed next steps:
1) Confirm economic buyer: Samantha, can you confirm Olivia Chen is the right person for final approval?
2) Procurement/security call: propose a 30–45m call next week with Tom (CISO), Rick (procurement), Rishi (me), and Camila (SE) to walk security pack and SOW.
3) We’ll share: (a) concise pricing summary + starter SOW, (b) SOC 2 evidence + security pack, (c) demo recording.

Attachments: redwood-pricing-mvp.pdf, demo-recording-20270318.mp4 (recording) — sending both here for your review.

Suggested meeting times (PDT): Tue 3/23 10:00–11:00, Wed 3/24 13:00–14:00, Thu 3/25 09:00–11:00. Please let us know what works.

Thanks — I’ll loop in Rishi + Camila on the procurement call invite when we have a time.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0182

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear recap. Quick clarifications from our side:

- Confirmed: Olivia Chen (CFO) will be the economic buyer / final approver. I can loop her in once we have a procurement-level SOW and estimate.
- Tom (CISO) flagged the need for our procurement and legal teams to see: SOC 2 Type II report, DPA language that supports our standard clauses, and a short network diagram for a VPC option.
- Rick Donovan (procurement) will coordinate contracts — copying him on this thread.

Can you confirm whether Redwood supports customer-managed KMS keys (we have a hard requirement for KMS for token storage)? Also we’d like to know if data residency to us-west-2 is possible for hosted mode — Elena is particularly interested in any latency numbers from us-west-2.

Tentatively the team would prefer Wed 3/24 13:00–13:45 PT for the security/procurement slot. Rishi’s participation would be useful for pricing and SOW details.

Also — can you send a one-page estimate (ballpark ARR or monthly) we can share with Olivia?

Samantha
